title: 第三十章 煞阵反噬白衣拦杀机第二十九章 郡城聚首首擂镇群雄
lines: 台喧哗震天，久久不散。
黑石城少主厉骁落败倒地，护卫匆匆登台将其抬离场地，少年嘴角溢血、经脉紊乱，即便事后服用丹药，短期内也难以修复气海损伤，彻底无缘本届武道盛会后续赛程。
边城出身，武徒三重巅峰，身法诡谲破煞，轻取郡城前十天才。
沈砚二字，彻底烙印在场每一名观战武者心底。
此前全场大多人皆轻视这名来自青阳城的少年，认定其只是靠着越级斩杀废功武师博取虚名，可方才一战，虚实残影游走全场，四两拨千斤拆解黑石霸体，心性、招式、应变，无一不是同辈顶尖水准。
“怪不得能废掉冥阁墨老，这份战力，绝非侥幸。”
“厉骁服食淬煞丹加持战力，还依托地底擒蛟煞阵加持，依旧落败，说明沈砚早已看破阵法全貌，早就做好应对之策。”
“冥阁此番势在必得，首轮落败，接下来必定派遣嫡系死士登台，后续擂台，就是死斗局。”
看台议论声此起彼伏，风向彻底扭转，从最初看衰沈砚，变为对半看好，不少中立势力已然开始观望站队。
侯府参赛阵营之内，一众侯府子弟神色敬畏更甚，看向沈砚的目光彻底褪去所有攀比之心。同为侯府同辈，他们深知厉骁实力强悍，换做自身登台，绝无可能如此轻松取胜。
执法长老秦守松了一口长气，紧绷眉头缓缓舒展，低声感慨：“幻风游身步融会贯通，对战节奏拿捏极致，不贪攻、不冒进，明明手握碾压战力，依旧稳扎稳打，此子心性，远超同龄武者。”
他方才全程凝神观战，看得一清二楚。沈砚从头到尾刻意压制蛟血脉力量，全程只用纯灵力与身法对敌，刻意隐藏底牌，就是为了防备冥阁后续死局围杀，留有余地，步步为营。
一旁阿禾攥紧双拳，眼底满是欣喜，却依旧保持清醒，压低声音提醒：“公子，高楼之上夜衍气息愈发阴冷，他已经彻底失去耐心，下一轮登台之人，必定是冥阁精心培养的嫡系死士，绝非厉骁这种外聘棋子可比。”
厉骁只是依附冥阁的外围势力子弟，执行力有限，可冥阁嫡系死士，自幼浸泡煞力修行，精通阵法配合搏杀，专门克制血脉武者，配合地底擒蛟煞阵，杀伤力翻倍。
“我知晓。”
沈砚立身擂台边角，垂眸看向脚下青石地砖，眼底平淡无波。方才对战之时，他刻意试探阵法底线，已然摸清完整阵法规则。
擒蛟煞阵以擂台整块地底灵脉为基，由夜衍亲手接引域外煞力浇筑而成，分为两层禁制。第一层浅层禁制，引动血脉血气躁动，也就是方才克制他的阵法效果；第二层深层禁制，全面锁死灵力流转，放大周身痛感，强行逼出武者血脉本源，专供夜衍隔空抽取蛟脉之力。
方才他刻意收敛血脉，躲过浅层禁制，可一旦遇上拼死搏杀的嫡系死士，对方会主动引动阵法第二层禁制，避无可避。
想要取胜，要么动用蛟鳞覆体硬破阵法，要么借助外力打断阵法运转。
“本轮休整半刻钟，接续抽签，第二轮对决即刻开启！”高台司仪扬声喊话，压下全场嘈杂人声，第二轮抽签玉筒再度流转各大势力席位。
贵宾席主位，郡守周凛指尖轻叩扶手，眸光沉沉望向对面云来客栈高楼黑衣身影，神色暗含忌惮。
他坐镇永安郡数十年，制衡本土各大势力，向来把控全局，可冥阁阁主夜衍入境之后，全然无视郡城规则，私自布设擂台煞阵，公然操控比武对局，已然触碰郡守底线。
可夜衍修为武师三重巅峰，距离武灵仅一步之遥，自身战力极强，麾下死士众多，贸然撕破脸面开战，会引发郡城大乱，伤及无数无辜武者，周凛一时投鼠忌器。
身侧白衣周清鸢手持玉柄长剑，侧身轻声开口：“父亲，地底煞力日渐浓郁，夜衍意在当众抽取沈砚蛟脉，借盛会万民见证，坐实天定祭品之名，日后便可名正言顺追杀沈砚，不受世间武道道义约束。”
她自幼修习观气秘术，可看透灵力、煞力流转轨迹，早已看清夜衍全盘谋划。
“为父明白。”周凛沉声叹气，“可我尚未彻底激活镇域阵印，正面抗衡夜衍胜算不足三成，一旦开战，郡城死伤惨重，只能静观其变，伺机出手。”
“女儿自有分寸。”周清鸢颔首，澄澈眼眸始终锁定擂台青衫身影，心底已然做好出手兜底的打算。
半刻钟休整转瞬结束，第二轮抽签完毕，公示木牌高悬看台正中。
乙二十九组，镇北侯府沈砚，对战冥阁直属死士，烬夜。
对阵信息公示刹那，全场瞬间死寂，随即爆发出远比之前更加汹涌的哗然！
“冥阁嫡系死士亲自登台了！不是附庸势力子弟，是阁内养大的煞修武者！”
“烬夜大名鼎鼎，半年前单人剿灭郡城反叛宗门，武徒三重巅峰修为，一身煞力功法杀伐狠辣，从不留对手活口！”
“完了，本轮是必死对局，厉骁只是试探，烬夜登台，就是要借阵法斩杀沈砚，杜绝一切翻盘可能！”
清风宗贵宾席位，一众宗门长老相视一笑，神色漠然冷眼旁观。清风宗早已暗中归顺冥阁，此番全程观战，就是为了见证沈砚被擒，后续助力冥阁接管陨蛟秘境。
高楼雅间，夜衍端起全新青瓷茶杯，紫眸淡漠俯视擂台，唇角勾起冷冽弧度。
“烬夜自幼以煞炼骨，与擒蛟煞阵同源共生，可全权催动第二层禁制。沈砚，这一轮，我看你如何隐匿蛟脉，如何全身而退。”
他放弃外围棋子，直接派出底牌死士，就是要一锤定音，擂台绝杀，不留变数。
“乙二十九组，冥阁烬夜，对战镇北侯府沈砚，登台开赛！”
司仪嗓音微微发紧，念出对阵名号之时，心底已然预判结局。
一道漆黑身影踏空掠上擂台，身形瘦削挺拔，身着一体式玄黑煞纹劲装，肌肤泛着病态灰白，双目全无眼白，通体漆黑空洞，周身萦绕缠绕丝丝缕缕域外阴煞，气息阴冷刺骨。
此人正是烬夜，无喜无悲，无痛无怒，完全被煞力驯化的杀人傀儡。
烬夜登台一瞬，脚下擂台地砖纹路尽数亮起，暗红煞光蔓延整块比武台，肉眼可见的黑色煞气升腾而起，笼罩方圆十丈擂台空间。
擒蛟煞阵，第二层禁制，全开！
无形锁脉之力轰然落下，精准锁定沈砚周身四肢百骸，这一次不再是躁动血气，而是强行拉扯骨血深处碧鳞蛟本源，想要逼血脉自主浮现在体表。
content_en:
The noise on the stage shook the sky and lasted for a long time.
The young master of Black Rock City, Li Xiao, fell to the ground in defeat. The guards hurriedly came on stage to lift him off the field. The young man's mouth was bleeding and his meridians were disordered. Even if he took pills afterwards, it would be difficult to repair the damage to the air sea in the short term, and he would be completely missed from the follow-up schedule of this martial arts event.
Born in a border city, he is at the peak of the third level of martial arts. His body skills are treacherous and can defeat evil spirits. He easily defeated the county city within ten days.
The word Shen Yan was completely engraved in the hearts of every martial artist present.
Previously, most people in the audience despised this young man from Qingyang City, believing that he only gained a false reputation by killing useless martial arts masters at a higher level. But just after the battle, the afterimages of the real and the real were wandering around the audience, and he used a thousand pounds to dismantle the black stone hegemon's body. His character, moves, and adaptability were all top-notch among his peers.
"No wonder I was able to destroy Mr. Mo of Ming Pavilion. This fighting power is definitely not a fluke."
"Li Xiao took the Evil Tempering Pill to increase his combat power, and also relied on the underground Jiao Evil Capturing Formation to support him, but he still lost. This shows that Shen Yan has already seen through the entire formation and has already prepared a countermeasure."
"Ming Ge is bound to win this time. If he loses in the first round, he will definitely send his direct descendants to the stage. The subsequent stage will be a death match."
Discussions in the stands started one after another, and the direction of the wind completely reversed. From initially being pessimistic about Shen Yan, it became about half optimistic, and many neutral forces had begun to wait and see whether to take sides.
In the Hou Mansion's participating camp, all the disciples of the Hou Mansion looked even more awe-struck. They looked at Shen Yan and completely lost all intention of comparison. As peers in the Hou Mansion, they knew very well that Li Xiao was very powerful, and there was no way he could win so easily if they were on the stage.
Law enforcement elder Qin Shou breathed a long sigh of relief, slowly relaxed his frown, and sighed in a low voice: "Huanfeng swims and moves well, and the rhythm of the battle is perfect. He is not greedy to attack, and he does not rush forward. He clearly has crushing combat power, but he still fights steadily. This child's character is far beyond that of a warrior of the same age."
He had just watched the whole battle attentively and saw everything clearly. Shen Yan deliberately suppressed the power of Jiao's bloodline from the beginning to the end. He only used pure spiritual power and physical skills to fight the enemy throughout the whole process, deliberately hiding his trump card, just to prevent the follow-up death attack of Ming Pavilion, leaving room for success and making every move.
Ah He on the side clenched his fists, his eyes full of joy, but he still remained awake, and lowered his voice to remind: "Master, Ye Yan's aura above the tall building is getting colder and colder. He has completely lost his patience. The next person to take the stage must be a direct lineage soldier carefully cultivated by Ming Pavilion, and cannot be compared to an external chess piece like Li Xiao."
Li Xiao is just a disciple of the peripheral forces attached to Ming Pavilion, and his execution ability is limited. However, Ming Pavilion is a direct descendant of the dead warriors. He has been immersed in the practice of evil forces since he was a child, and is proficient in formations to coordinate fighting. He specializes in restraining bloodline warriors, and cooperates with the underground dragon capture formation to double his lethality.
"I know."
Shen Yan stood at the corner of the arena, looking down at the bluestone floor tiles under his feet, his eyes dull. During the battle just now, he deliberately tested the bottom line of the formation and already understood the complete rules of the formation.
The formation to capture the dragon evil is based on the entire underground spiritual vein of the arena. It was cast by Ye Yan personally by channeling the evil power from outside the territory. It is divided into two layers of restrictions. The first layer of shallow restrictions caused the blood and blood to become restless, which was the effect of the formation that restrained him just now; the second layer of deep restrictions completely blocked the flow of spiritual power, amplified the pain all over the body, and forced out the origin of the warrior's blood, specifically for Ye Yan to draw the power of the dragon's veins through the air.
Just now, he deliberately restrained his bloodline to avoid the shallow restrictions, but once he encountered a direct lineage soldier who was fighting to the death, the opponent would actively trigger the second layer of restrictions in the formation, making it inevitable.
If you want to win, you must either use the dragon scale covering to forcefully break the formation, or use external force to interrupt the operation of the formation.
"Half an hour's rest in this round, the lottery will continue, and the second round of the duel will begin immediately!" The master of ceremonies on the high platform shouted, suppressing the noisy people in the audience, and the jade tube of the second round of lottery once again circulated the seats of the major forces.
At the VIP table, County Sheriff Zhou Lin tapped the handrail with his fingertips, looking at the figure in black on the tall building of Yunlai Inn across from him with deep eyes, his expression hinting at fear.
He has been in Yong'an County for decades, checking and balancing the major local forces, and has always controlled the overall situation. However, after entering the Ming Pavilion, Ye Yan, the master of the Ming Pavilion, completely ignored the rules of the county, secretly set up an arena and blatantly manipulated the competition, which had already touched the county guard's bottom line.
But Ye Yan was at the third level of the martial arts peak, just one step away from martial arts. He had extremely strong combat power and many dead soldiers under his command. If he rashly started a war with his face, it would cause chaos in the county and city, and hurt countless innocent warriors. Zhou Lin was afraid of it.
Zhou Qingyuan, who was dressed in white and held a long sword with a jade handle beside him, turned sideways and spoke softly: "Father, the underground evil force is getting stronger and stronger day by day. Ye Yan intends to extract the veins of Shen Yan in public, and use the witness of the grand gathering to confirm the name of the sacrifice of heaven. In the future, he can justifiably hunt down Shen Yan without being bound by the morals of martial arts in the world."
She has practiced the secret art of Qi contemplation since she was a child, and can see through the flow of spiritual power and evil power, and has already seen Ye Yan's overall plan clearly.
"My father understands." Zhou Lin sighed deeply, "But I haven't fully activated the town formation seal yet, and the chance of winning against Ye Yan head-on is less than 30%. Once the war starts, the county will suffer heavy casualties, so we can only wait and see what happens and wait for the opportunity to take action."
"A daughter has her own sense of proportion." Zhou Qingyuan nodded, her clear eyes always locked on the figure in green shirt on the stage, and she was already planning to take action.
The half-quarter-of-an-hour break ended in an instant, the second round of draws was completed, and the wooden sign was hung high in the center of the stands.
Group B twenty-nine, Zhenbei Hou Mansion Shen Yan, fighting against the dead soldier directly under Ming Pavilion, Jin Ye.
The moment the matchup information was announced, the entire audience was silent for a moment, and then an uproar that was far more violent than before broke out!
"The dead man who is a direct descendant of Ming Pavilion has appeared on the stage in person! He is not a child of a vassal force, but a Sha cultivator raised in the pavilion!"
"Jin Ye is famous. He single-handedly wiped out the rebel sect in the county half a year ago. He is a third-level martial arts disciple at the peak of his cultivation. He is a ruthless killer with his evil skills and never leaves his opponents alive!"
"It's over. This round is a fatal match. Li Xiao is just testing. Jin Ye is on stage to use the formation to kill Shen Yan and eliminate any possibility of a comeback!"
In the VIP seats of Qingfeng Sect, all the elders of the sect smiled at each other and looked on with indifferent expressions. The Qingfeng Sect had already secretly surrendered to Ming Pavilion, and they were watching the whole battle this time just to witness Shen Yan's capture and later help Ming Pavilion take over the secret realm of the Meteoric Dragon.
In the elegant room of a high-rise building, Ye Yan picked up a brand new celadon tea cup, looking down at the ring with his purple eyes indifferently, and the corners of his lips curled up in a cold arc.
"Jin Ye has been refining his bones with evil spirits since he was a child. He has the same origin and symbiosis with the dragon evil capture formation. He has full power to activate the second level of restrictions. Shen Yan, this round, I will see how you hide the dragon's veins and how you escape completely."
He gave up the peripheral chess pieces and directly sent out his trump card, the dead man, just to make the final decision and win in the arena without leaving any variables.
"Group B twenty-nine, Ming Pavilion Jinye, versus Zhenbei Hou Mansion Shen Yan, take the stage to start the competition!"
The emcee's voice was slightly tight, and when he read out the name of the match, he had already predicted the outcome in his heart.
A dark figure flew into the air and flew onto the ring. He was tall and thin, wearing an all-in-one suit with black evil patterns. His skin was sickly gray, his eyes had no whites at all, and his whole body was pitch black and hollow. The body was surrounded by strands of extraterrestrial evil spirits, and his aura was cold and biting.
This person is Jin Ye, a murderous puppet with no joy, no sorrow, no pain, no anger, completely tamed by evil power.
The moment Jin Ye took the stage, all the tile patterns on the floor of the arena lit up under his feet, and a dark red evil light spread across the entire competition stage. Black evil energy visible to the naked eye rose up and enveloped the ten-foot-wide arena space.
The dragon capture formation, the second level of restrictions, is fully open!
Buzz——
The invisible power of locking the veins suddenly fell, locking precisely on all the limbs and bones of Shen Yan's body. This time, it was no longer a matter of restless blood, but a forceful pull on the source of the green-scaled dragon deep in the bone and blood, trying to force the blood to emerge on its own surface.
title_en: Chapter 30: The evil formation backfires in white clothes to stop the murderous intention. Chapter 29: The county and city gather together to challenge the heroes.
